description: RULED S478 item 1: a whole-cell AUTHOR write (`@users = []`) into a `let` pending tape `(not to User[])` whose type grants no `replace` is E-WRITE-NOT-GRANTED, the same refusal any tape without `[replace]` gets. `let` and the lifecycle grant a tape nothing; the compiler-written settle write of the cell's own load stays exempt (the declaration itself compiles).
rationale: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — S477 owner questions 1 and 2" item 1: "A whole-cell author write into a pending `(not to S[…])` tape needs the `[replace]` grant like any other tape; the compiler-written settle write stays exempt (S475 item 1)." §66.12.3: a sequence's grants live on its type; `let` on a sequence is E-GRANT-LET-ON-SEQUENCE. §13.9.1 S475 rule 5: "The compiler-written load writes are exempt from grant checks."
